title: Kissed Crunchy Algerian Chicken Tagine
description: A funky and festive Algerian dish featuring prosciutto and flambe, made diabetic-friendly with careful ingredient selection. This recipe combines the richness of chicken and prosciutto with the warmth of spices.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the chopped prosciutto, cooking until crispy.
Remove the prosciutto from the skillet and set aside, leaving the grease behind.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it starts to caramelize.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the skillet from the oven and stir in the crispy prosciutto.
Flambe the dish by igniting the sauce with a match or lighter, being careful not to burn yourself.
